style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: brown chocolate keys with a berry Enter clash with neither the a.m. sky blue nor the p.m. amber of the day strip, and sit apart from the objects' colours

images.object: bright golden-yellow sun disc with short soft rays
images.why: Student controls 'Sun slider: moves the sun along the day strip'; Stage 'a high sun at the middle at x 560' and 'a sunrise over a small school': the sun marker on the strip and the sun slider's thumb
images.prompt: A round glowing sun in bright golden yellow with a warm orange centre and short, soft, rounded rays all round it, a smooth glossy surface.

images.object: pale cream crescent moon with a soft glow
images.why: Stage 'a moon over a street lamp at x 130, y 560 and again at x 1000, y 560': the night marker at each end of the day strip, and the slider's thumb once the sun has set
images.prompt: A single crescent moon in pale buttery cream with a soft warm-golden edge and a few faint shallow craters, a smooth glossy surface.

images.object: small cream school building with an orange tiled roof
images.why: Stage 'a sunrise over a small school is painted at x 130, y 300' and the owner's 'a school morning': the school under the rising sun at the morning end of the strip
images.prompt: A small village school drawn from the front like a child's picture: a long low single-storey building with warm cream walls, a terracotta-orange roof, a row of tall windows, a wooden double door in the middle under a small bell tower, and a small plain saffron flag on a pole.

images.object: tall street lamp with a dark-brown pole and a glowing warm-yellow lantern
images.why: Stage 'a moon over a street lamp' and the owner's 'a street at night': the lamp that stands under the moon at each end of the day strip
images.prompt: A street lamp drawn from the side like a child's picture: a slim dark-brown iron pole with a short curved arm at the top reaching to one side and holding a small lantern with pale warm-yellow glass. The light stays inside the glass, with no glow, halo or rays around the lamp.

images.object: mustard-yellow twin-bell alarm clock with a plain blank cream face
images.why: Student controls 'Picture cards: an alarm clock ...' dropped on the strip: the card for waking up in the morning Its face stays blank: draw no hands or marks on it (they would show a time that competes with the time card). Drawn on its own cream card, because it is orange and would sink on the amber p.m. half.
images.prompt: A round mustard-yellow metal alarm clock with a pair of small brass bells on top, short legs and a small hammer between the bells, its round face completely plain and blank cream, with no hands and no marks of any kind.

images.object: orange canvas school backpack with tan straps, front view
images.why: Student controls 'Picture cards: ... a school bag ...': the card for going to school in the morning Drawn on its own cream card, because it is orange and would sink on the amber p.m. half.
images.prompt: A child's orange canvas school backpack with tan straps and a zipped front pocket, seen from the front, soft folds in the fabric.

images.object: bright orange plastic lunch box with a snap-on lid, closed
images.why: Student controls 'Picture cards: ... a lunch box ...': the card for eating lunch at noon, the item the brief says a child puts wrongly on a.m. Drawn on its own cream card, because it is orange and would sink on the amber p.m. half.
images.prompt: A closed rectangular school lunch box in bright orange glossy plastic with a lighter lid and yellow snap clips, rounded corners, seen from above.

images.object: orange leather football with black panels
images.why: Student controls 'Picture cards: ... a football ...' and the owner's 'playing in the evening': the card for evening play Drawn on its own cream card, because it is orange and would sink on the amber p.m. half.
images.prompt: A round orange synthetic-leather football with black panels and neat stitched seams, a slightly glossy surface.

images.object: round terracotta-orange ceramic dinner plate with a wide rim
images.why: Student controls 'Picture cards: ... a dinner plate ...': the card for eating dinner in the evening Drawn on its own cream card, because it is orange and would sink on the amber p.m. half.
images.prompt: A round glazed terracotta-orange ceramic dinner plate with a wide gently raised rim and a deeper well in the centre, empty, seen from above.

images.object: single wooden bed with a mustard-yellow quilt and a peach pillow
